description: This file defines React components 'RequireAuth' and 'RequireRole' that handle authentication and authorization logic in a Next.js frontend application. It utilizes context, hooks, and routing to enforce access control based on user authentication status and roles.

methods.name: RequireAuth
methods.description: A React component that enforces user authentication, redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.

methods.name: RequireRole
methods.description: A React component that enforces user role-based access control, displaying an access denied message if the user lacks the required role.
